acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition
After elution, the peptides were ionized under positive electrospray conditions and subjected to data-dependent acquisition mode for analysis.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Subsequent alkylation with 20 mM IAA in 25 mM (NH4)HCO3 for 45 min at 600 rpm and 25 °C in the dark was undertaken, followed by centrifugation at 14,000 x g for 20 min.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Subsequent alkylation with 20 mM IAA in 25 mM (NH4)HCO3 for 45 min at 600 rpm and 25 °C in the dark was undertaken, followed by centrifugation at 14,000 x g for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested on-filter overnight at 37 °C and 100 rpm with trypsin (1:25 w/w).

collision_energy.evidence: A quadrupole transmission window of 1.2 m/z was used to filter the ions, which were then subjected to HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30.

fragmentation_method.evidence: A quadrupole transmission window of 1.2 m/z was used to filter the ions, which were then subjected to HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30.

ionization_type.evidence: After elution, the peptides were ionized under positive electrospray conditions and subjected to data-dependent acquisition mode for analysis.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Protein abundance was calculated using the LFQ algorithm present in MaxQuant software.

mass_analyzer.evidence: The fragments were detected by the orbitrap mass analyzer with a resolution of 30,000.

ptm.evidence: The precursor and fragment error mass tolerances were set at 4.5 ppm and 20 ppm, respectively, with cysteine carbamidomethylation as fixed modification.

The variable modifications set were: including methionine oxidation, N-terminal acetylation and deamination of arginine residues (citrullination, set as an increase of +0.98401 Da with a neutral loss of 43.0058 Da (HCNO) in arginine residues).
